item.title: Solved: How to Fix 'Read-only File System' Error in AWS Lambda When Downloading Files from S3
item.description:
When developing AWS Lambda functions, one might encounter various errors due to the unique environment these functions operate in. A common issue that arises when attempting to download files from an Amazon S3 bucket is the error indicating a “Read-only file system.” Specifically, this error might manifest as follows:

[Errno 30] Read-only file system: u'/file.csv.6CEdFe7C': IOError

The Problem

Consider a scenario where you have a Lambda function triggered by an S3 event, and the function is set to download a CSV file. Even if the file size is small, there’s a subtle complication you might face. During the download process, an unexpected suffix like .6CEdFe7C gets appended to the file name, leading to the aforementioned error. Despite implementing measures like introducing a 60-second sleep before opening the file, the issue persists.
